items.text: We’ve just released a new patch for Kamikaze Lassplanes that gives you more control over how you experience the game. This is your story, whether you’re more into visual novels or SHMUP action, the adventure in Velestia is now even more tailored to your playstyle!

With the new “Enable Force Skip” option in the settings, you can choose whether VN elements can be skipped even during your first playthrough. This allows you to quickly move from one mission to another and focus on the action if that’s what you enjoy most. We know some of you are more action-oriented pilots, so we wanted to make this experience more convenient for you.

items.text: Pilots!

Today is a big day for Kamikaze Lassplanes. The game has just been released on the Japanese eShop and is now available for Japanese players on Nintendo Switch! We're continuing to work on making it available in other regions, but to celebrate today's launch, we've prepared a major update for you.

We’re constantly working on bringing the game to as many languages as possible, and we’re happy to announce that Kamikaze Lassplanes is now available in Simplified Chinese! We hope that this update will allow Alba and Hanna’s adventure to reach a brand-new audience of players.
At the same time, we’ve introduced a new feature designed especially for our Streamer community.

By enabling the Streamer Mode option in the settings menu, you can now stream the game on even the most restrictive platforms without any issues! Streamer Mode activates a more SFW version of the game’s illustrations.
Additionally, the patch fixes several issues related to the other language versions of the game and includes small tweaks to further improve Kamikaze Lassplanes.
As always, we look forward to your feedback and comments!
Inky Dreams Crew
Simplified Chinese added as a language option;
Streamer Mode added
Fixed language-related bugs;

items.text: Pilots!
We hope you're enjoying your first two weeks with Kamikaze Lassplanes. Over this time, we've been analyzing and implementing features and fixes based on your feedback.
Thank you for all your reviews—don’t hesitate to share your thoughts in the review section or on the community hub. Your opinions matter to us!

Today, we're proud to present Patch 1.2, which brings a major quality-of-life improvement: the ability to "Skip Mission." This feature allows you to skip any gameplay mission that you've already completed in a previous playthrough. The patch also includes various gameplay fixes and a rework of the player hitbox in the SHMUP sections—we've listened to your feedback and redesigned the hitbox size.
The full changelog is available below.
Thank you for playing! We hope you enjoy the story of Walter, Alba, and Hannah as much as we do.
Inky Dreams Crew
-Introduced a mission skip feature for previously completed shoot 'em up (shmup) missions;
-Reduced the damage duration of Flying Mine enemies;
-Decreased Harbinger boss health in Story, Easy, and Normal modes;
-Reduced hitbox sizes for Alba and Hannah;
-Corrected visual effects for Power-Ups;
-Fixed a soft-lock issue with the Flying Mine enemy in the tutorial;
-Resolved an issue preventing players from moving to the left edge of the screen on Steam Deck;
-Fixed a desynchronization between English voiceovers and Japanese text in the diary sections;
-Addressed a bug where the pause menu would malfunction if triggered simultaneously with the choice panel;
